title: YieldVault Webhook Verification Challenge
description: Body of the one-time challenge request YieldVault POSTs to a newly registered endpoint (and the shape the consumer must echo back) before any real events are delivered. Source of truth: probeWebhookVerification in backend/src/webhookDelivery.ts.

challenge.description: Opaque random token. Also sent in the X-YieldVault-Challenge request header. The consumer must return the same value, either in the X-YieldVault-Challenge response header or as { "challenge": "<token>" } in the response body, for the endpoint to move to verificationStatus: "verified".
